review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: Implement visible read retry, compact grouped process display and stable echo handoff
review.notes: User screenshot reports weak/no-op Retry, identical chain rows with verbose replay caveat, long awaiting-confirmation and jumping duplicate echo. Producer already tracks unique PID with repeated-incarnation validation; identical sanitized nodes are distinct processes, so group count rather than claim duplicate source. Presentation only: no raw argv or authority/privacy changes. Read lanes stay bounded, explicit retry invalidates stale lane/ETag; no model-mutation retry. Echo uses existing attachment-aware identity+new occurrence baseline, stable source/optimistic key, never receipt-only execution proof; no rapid polling or fake timing. Schema/installed180 sources unchanged. All UI tests synthetic; no real screen/TCC/session send. Design committed before test edits; preserve meaningful older identity/permission guards and re-review copy expectations. Harness correction before browser test implementation: this repository uses Node+Playwright .test.cjs, not .spec.ts. Before browser regression edits, include existing browser profile assertions: only obsolete verbosity/action label expectations change; session/time, late result, authorization and copying guards remain. Echo mount test counts native View instances rather than composite/host duplicates; dependency setup failures retained separately. New user asks all analogous user-facing state copy audited: remove implementation explanations, keep concise distinct empty/loading/failed/read-only/queued states and actionable reload or existing Terminal navigation; do not change legal/security grants or invent action availability. Fresh implementation-owner review before replaying the App copy/loading refresh on an unpublished successor branch. Original50503e8c and its failed exact-history gate remain preserved on the old branch and in task evidence; no retrospective chronology claim or checker change. This fresh review covers CRX-001, CRX-005, CRX-006. Keep every existing auth/304/current-reader/late-answer/no-copy/identity/empty-vs-unknown assertion and44pt/busy/layout guard. Apply the previously declared RFD-002 concise initial/retry-failed, profile loading/failure/confirmed-empty copy and shared three-pane loader; RSR-009 keeps62pt/two-line rows while actual notification sync occupies the second line and owner More menu exposes one targeted retry. New RFD/PFR designs retain their earlier commits. Reapply the identical505 implementation after this design commit; original failing branch is never rewritten or pushed. Independent93 R1/P2 at exact340ba658 reviewed before the follow-up test/code edit: process Retry inherits the conversation-only accessible name through ReadFeedback. Add an optional scope-specific accessible label while retaining ConversationReload default conversation semantics. Extend existing PCP-001 bilingual failed-process retry assertions and CRX-001/RFD-002 bilingual conversation label assertions; keep original callback,44pt,busy,timeout,wrong-source and no-copy checks. Case expectations and mappings remain within their prior reviewed scope; no historical case replacement or checker change. No local Go/Jest/npm/native/cache run; validate on the new exact normal cloud CI. Preserve REQUEST_CHANGES, old CI and unresolved continuous source-pool accounting.
